copy.headline: No Safe Corner
copy.deck: Two contenders. Changing angles. No comfortable position.
copy.body: Slob on my Dobb broke for central cover. Paint snapped against the bunker as he slid behind it. Across the lane, Three Dreaded Snake moved again. Three protected heads watched three openings. Neither could wait. Every advance gained ground and surrendered protection.

scene.emotional_spine: Every advance gains an angle and sacrifices protection; the victory must be earned by a visible flank.
scene.ground_plan: From the west sideline: Slob on my Dobb starts southwest/near-left, Three Dreaded Snake northeast/far-right. A cylinder, central low bunker and northeast wedge define the lanes; trees and distant camp remain behind. Inflatable covers are stationary. A final pivoting camera is re-established before the behind-winner view.
anchors: central low bunker and open middle lane
northeast wedge with rear tree line

beats.shot: Wide sideline opening, both origins visible
beats.pose_and_physical_action: Slob on my Dobb breaks from the near-left starting cylinder toward central low cover while Three Dreaded Snake pivots around the far-right wedge, bringing his marker onto the lane. Both markers remain controlled; no paint hits either player. The shared tree line and stationary bunkers match P36.
beats.what_changes: The established starting positions become the first exposed crossing.
beats.transition: The main image shows the crossing ending in a slide.

beats.pose_and_physical_action: Slob on my Dobb drives from cylinder toward central low cover as Three Dreaded Snake leans from the far wedge. Paint lands on inflatable cover, not either player.
beats.what_changes: The first crossing exposes a cost while gaining ground.
beats.transition: Inset follows the slide from the same left-to-right direction.

beats.shot: Medium Slob on my Dobb slide inset
beats.pose_and_physical_action: His current heavyset human build compresses into a short slide; soil scuffs follow the travel direction. Mask stays on; no stale horned redesign.
beats.what_changes: A forceful advance ends in a defensible position, not victory.
beats.transition: Countercut to the opponent using the information.

beats.shot: Medium Three Dreaded Snake counter-move inset
beats.pose_and_physical_action: Three Dreaded Snake leaves the wedge for adjacent tree cover. Central head tracks Slob on my Dobb; outer heads watch flanks; three necks join one body and marker stays below the faces.
beats.what_changes: The defender changes position rather than freezing for the next shot.
beats.transition: Turn before either finds a clean final hit.

scene.page_turn_out: Both are moving; which new angle will actually defeat cover?
